name: emdash-commerce-cloudflare
description: Unofficial community demo: a mock Cloudflare-merch storefront on EmDash (Astro) with Stripe Checkout, running on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2. Generated from zawoj/emdash-commerce.

EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts secrets EmDash stores in D1 (plugin settings, the order-link secret). Format `emdash_enc_v1_` + 43 base64url characters: generate it with `npx emdash secrets generate`. A hex key is rejected. Never change it once the database holds a secret.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe **secret or restricted key** (`sk_test_...` / `rk_test_...` for a sandbox). Create it in the [Stripe dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys). A key saved in the admin (Plugins, Stripe commerce, Settings) wins over this one.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Signing secret (`whsec_...`) of the webhook endpoint. Leave it empty and press **Register webhook** in the Commerce admin page instead: the secret is then stored encrypted in the database.

COMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Optional. Signs the guest order links in emails. Generated and stored encrypted on first use when left empty.

DB.description: D1 database: the EmDash schema, content, orders and plugin storage. Migrations run on the first request.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for uploaded media (product photos).
